questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks the end of a road work zone. Normal traffic rules and speed limits resume beyond this point.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Shoulder may be soft — do not drive on it
Pull over to the shoulder and stop
Shoulder work ahead — workers on the shoulder

questions.correctAnswerText: Shoulder work ahead — workers on the shoulder
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers are performing maintenance or construction on the road shoulder. Drive carefully and give workers extra space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road work zone continues for the next 5 miles
Speed limit enforced for the next 5 miles

questions.correctAnswerText: Road work zone continues for the next 5 miles
questions.explanation: This sign warns that road construction or maintenance continues for the next 5 miles. Maintain reduced speed and watch for workers and equipment throughout the zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Flagger ahead — be prepared to stop or follow directions

questions.correctAnswerText: Flagger ahead — be prepared to stop or follow directions
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger (person directing traffic) is working ahead in a construction zone. Be prepared to slow down, stop, or follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road shoulder under repair — do not use

questions.explanation: This sign warns of maintenance activity on the road shoulder. Stay in your lane and be alert for workers and equipment near the edge of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Power lines overhead — high clearance vehicles stop
Underground construction — road may be uneven
Utility work ahead — proceed with caution

questions.correctAnswerText: Utility work ahead — proceed with caution
questions.explanation: This sign warns that utility crews are working ahead on power lines, gas lines, or other infrastructure. Slow down and be alert for workers and equipment on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No stopping on the right side

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right shoulder of the road is closed due to construction. Drivers should stay in the travel lanes and not use the shoulder.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Detour ahead — follow the alternate route

questions.correctAnswerText: Detour ahead — follow the alternate route
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign indicates the normal route is temporarily closed. Follow the detour arrows to an alternate route around the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers are on or near the road ahead. Slow down, be alert, and be prepared to stop. Fines are often doubled in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates the upcoming exit is temporarily closed due to construction or maintenance. Drivers should use an alternate exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow vehicles must use right lane

questions.explanation: This sign warns that slow-moving traffic is ahead, often due to construction. Reduce your speed and be prepared for sudden stops.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right two lanes closed one mile ahead
Road narrows to one lane in one mile
Highway splits into two roads ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Right two lanes closed one mile ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the two right lanes will be closed one mile ahead due to road work. Drivers in those lanes should merge left safely before the closure.
